note: Estimates for gameplay, NOT real player statistics. Preserve existing source observations and identities. Apply by exact ID only. Never replace actual statistical measurements.

calibration.clubSquadMedian: per club median of pre-existing V6 rating
calibration.leagueSquadMedian: median club squad median within league
calibration.availabilityDelta: historical minutes (2024-25) or verified 2025-26 performance, -1 to +2
calibration.attackAttributesDelta: TOP14 2025-26 regular phase club tries versus sampled league mean, round((tries-mean)/18), capped ±2, 8 offensive attributes only
calibration.potentialDelta: club delta and age adjustment (<=22:+2; <=25:+1; >=33:-1), not lower than new rating
calibration.noEvidencePolicy: Keep baseline when no directly relevant evidence; never convert missing statistics to zero.
